page.overview:
Who is Aunt Edith?

Aunt Edith is a member of Marge Simpson's family. Like most of Marge's family, she has a strong dislike of Homer, this was evidenced when she allowed Marge and the kids to stay at her vineyard, but on one condition, no Homer.
